topic: Campione d'Italia Italian enclave in Switzerland
hook: Your walk here stays in Italy, inside Switzerland.
title: An Italian town completely inside Switzerland
description:
Campione d'Italia is an Italian town that sits entirely inside Swiss territory, right on Lake Lugano. To drive there from Italy you have to cross Switzerland. Places That Shouldn't Exist, part of a series.
